31324-(R1844).s: The bill amends the Paspoortwet to centralise the travel-document administration in a single national register with fingerprint data, and to let the executive set many detailed rules by general administrative order (AMvB) and ministerial regulation. It also adds a pre-issuance check for duplicate or false-identity applications and allows issuance and delivery procedures to be simplified.
31324-(R1844).j: The memorandum justifies the wide delegation to general administrative orders by the need for technical flexibility and the new biometric data and single online register, and it argues the privacy interference is proportionate and foreseeable.
q: In almost all provisions of this bill, the delegation power has accordingly been placed at the level of the general administrative order.
In vrijwel alle bepalingen in dit voorstel van rijkswet is de delegatiebevoegdheid dan ook op het niveau van de algemene maatregel van rijksbestuur gebracht.
d: other travel documents, validity periods, territorial validity
model of identity and travel documents and their production
which data may be omitted; photo and fingerprint requirements and exceptions
data recorded in the travel document administration, data suppliers, management and security, protection rules
which bodies may receive data from the administration and on what conditions
who may receive other categories of travel documents and under what conditions
exceptions to personal appearance for applications and how biometrics are obtained
who may keep a second valid Dutch travel document and under what conditions
rules on the declaration of loss of a document
exempting certain documents from the duplicate-application check
exceptions to personal appearance at issuance
when and how documents are withdrawn from circulation
administrative implementation and security of the issuing process
p: Allows the centralised register with biometric data to be made available to a wide range of bodies for fraud, investigation and state-security purposes, expanding executive access to citizens' data, subject to purpose limits and logging.
Introduces a pre-issuance ministerial investigation of applicants for possible duplicate or false-identity applications before a document is issued.

Centralises travel-document data and leaves its detailed content, retention and destruction to general administrative orders, with access rules set outside the statute, though inspection and objection rights under the data protection law remain.

parties: Asks about the one-person-one-passport principle, retention of facial images, and whether the central database should be usable for criminal investigation of all offences, emphasising privacy protection.
Why, these members ask, has the government not made these data available in this bill for investigating suspects of all crimes and offences?
Waarom, zo vragen deze leden, heeft de regering de toepassing van deze gegevens in dit wetsvoorstel niet mogelijk gemaakt bij de opsporing van verdachten van alle misdrijven en overtredingen?
Asks who gets access to the central database for criminal-law purposes, who must authorise such access, and for which purposes it may be used.
Can the government give a clear overview of the purposes for which the database may and may not be used and who may use it for which purposes?
Kan de regering een helder overzicht geven voor welke doeleinden de databank wel en niet mag worden gebruikt en wie er voor welke doeleinden gebruik van mag maken?

Doubts the necessity of fingerprints in a central database, objects to the many delegated regulations (26 nadere regels), fears it becomes an investigation register and function creep, and questions error rates and remedies for citizens.
Does the government share these members' concerns that the central database will in practice become an investigation register?
Deelt de regering de zorgen van deze leden dat de centrale database in de praktijk een opsporingsregister wordt?
Seeks balance between fraud control and privacy, asks about protection of biometric data against theft, appeal options when wrongly involved in an investigation, and conscientious objectors.
What objection options exist if it turns out citizens are wrongly involved in a police investigation?
Welke bezwaarmogelijkheden zijn er als blijkt dat burgers ten onrechte in een politieonderzoek worden betrokken?
Asks what remedies a citizen has when their data is nonetheless misused, and whether a different regime can apply to people with conscientious objections.
Can a different regime be applied to them, for example as for children?
Kan voor hen, bijvoorbeeld net als voor kinderen, een afwijkend regime worden getroffen?

Raises fundamental objections of part of the population to biometrics and privacy, asks whether those with conscientious objections can choose shorter-validity documents, and asks about recent research on public resistance.
They would like to hear from the government to what extent this bill is necessary within current European standards.
Graag vernemen zij van de regering in hoeverre dit wetsvoorstel binnen de huidige Europese normen noodzakelijk is.

31924-XV.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (slotwet) that amends the 2008 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget of its baten-lastendienst agencies, setting final figures in thousands of euros. It has no delegation of rule-making power, and no explanatory memorandum excerpts were available.
q: We Beatrix... have resolved and decided... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2008 is amended
Wij Beatrix... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2008 wordt gewijzigd

32360-XIII.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement and the baten-lastendiensten budget of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) by setting revised appropriations, as set out in the attached schedules. It is a budget-adjustment (slotwet) bill that takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We, in joint consultation with the States General, have resolved and decreed as follows: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs (XIII) for 2009 is amended as shown in the attached statement.

Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken (XIII) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd

32500-XIV.s: This bill fixes the 2011 departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (LNV) and the 2011 operating budgets of six service agencies, including the Algemene Inspectiedienst, Dienst Regelingen and Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and its entry into force on 1 January 2011.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2011 attached to this law is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

33280-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and sets aside a multi-year budget reserve under Article 3, deviating from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 to fund guarantees for residual debts of education institutions. The explanatory memorandum says a general statutory provision is planned, and until then the deviation will be repeated in the annual budget law.
33280-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the deviation from the Comptabiliteitswet on administrative efficiency, noting that five separate reserves would be inefficient and that a general statutory provision is planned.
q: From a standpoint of administrative efficiency, it is not desirable to maintain five separate budget reserves
Uit een oogpunt van administratieve doelmatigheid is het niet gewenst dat er vijf aparte begrotingsreserves worden aangehouden
p: Article 3 departs from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 to allow a multi-year budget reserve for guarantees, a deviation the memorandum says will be repeated annually in the budget law until a general provision exists.

33400-XVI.s: This bill sets the 2013 departmental budget and budget statements for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, including operating-cost agencies, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes spending and policy priorities but contains no delegation of rule-making power or shift of powers to the executive.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2013 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33640-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and creates a multi-year budget reserve for state guarantees on loans, overriding a provision of the Comptability Act 2001 for 2013. It takes effect on 1 June 2013 and sets the spending revisions across education, culture and media artikelen.
33640-VIII.j: The memorandum justifies the reserve on administrative efficiency grounds, avoiding five separate reserves until a general statutory provision is adopted in the planned Comptability Act revision.
q: For reasons of administrative efficiency it is not desirable to hold five separate budget reserves charged to the relevant policy articles.
Uit een oogpunt van administratieve doelmatigheid is het niet gewenst dat er vijf aparte begrotingsreserves worden aangehouden ten laste van de betrokken beleidsartikelen.
p: Article 3 deviates from article 5(4) of the Comptability Act 2001 by holding a multi-year budget reserve for guarantees for 2013, a technical budget departure.

33805-XV.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget statement for its executive agencies, in line with the autumn budget revision (Najaarsnota). It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force on 1 December 2013.
33805-XV.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the changes by higher-than-estimated use of the repatriation scheme and by not drawing on the unforeseen-expenses budget any further.
q: Use of the remigration scheme turned out in 2013 to be greater than estimated (€1,800 million).
Het beroep op de remigratieregeling is in 2013 groter gebleken dan geraamd (€ 1,800 miljoen).

33940-XV.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and of its agency SZW, in thousands of euros, following the spring memorandum. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power and no shift of power to the executive; it only changes appropriation figures and sets the effective date.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34210-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (first supplementary budget), adjusting appropriations across policy and non-policy articles in thousands of euros. It also notes that unused care-growth funds are shifted from 2015 to 2016 and 2017 and that the Wlz personal budget ceiling is raised.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement annexed to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34237-(R2054).s: The bill amends several Dutch and Caribbean statutes (Consular Act, Passport Act, Patent Act, Cassation Act for Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten and the BES islands, Emergency Shipping Provisions Act, International Criminal Court Implementation Act) to align them with the KEI reforms on digitalising and simplifying civil procedure, replacing summons and court-name terminology and transferring the Cassation Act to allow prejudicial questions to the Supreme Court from Caribbean courts. It also sets transitional rules and leaves the entry-into-force date to royal decree.
34237-(R2054).j: The memorandum justifies the delegation to set appearance deadlines and entry-into-force dates as technical implementation of the KEI procedural reforms.
q: The deadlines for appearance are set by general administrative order (algemene maatregel van rijksbestuur).
De termijnen van verschijning worden bij algemene maatregel van rijksbestuur vastgesteld.
d: entry into force of articles by royal decree
deadlines for appearance in cassation cases

parties: Welcomes digitisation and simplification of procedure and asks how often Caribbean judges will use the extended prejudicial question procedure.
They regard the digitisation and simplification of procedural law as a great good.
De digitalisering en vereenvoudiging van het procesrecht zien zij als een groot goed.
Asks whether overseas territories can digitise at the same pace, who bears the costs, and how delays are absorbed without harming judicial quality.
Who bears this delay, and how are the additional costs absorbed without putting the quality of the judiciary under pressure?
Voor wiens rekening komt deze vertraging en hoe worden de meerkosten opgevangen zonder dat de kwaliteit van de rechtspraak onder druk komt te staan?
Has no substantive objections and asks how the motion-Oskam is taken into account in implementing KEI.
They are also curious how, within the implementation of the KEI programme, account is currently being taken of the execution of the Oskam motion.
Zij zijn ook benieuwd hoe binnen de implementatie van het KEI-programma momenteel rekening wordt gehouden met de uitvoering van de motie-Oskam.
Asks which obstacles to digital procedures the bill removes and whether there are indirect budget effects, including the 140 million euro cost overrun.
The business case for KEI has meanwhile been sent to the House of Representatives.
Inmiddels is de business case voor KEI naar de Tweede Kamer gezonden.

Asks whether lawyers with a stage-verklaring may file written observations in prejudicial proceedings before the Hoge Raad, and whether the Afl 400 cassation threshold should be anchored in law, touching on access to review by the highest court.
Written observations not signed by a lawyer of the Hoge Raad are set aside.
Schriftelijke opmerkingen die niet door een advocaat bij de Hoge Raad zijn ondertekend worden ter zijde gelegd.

34263-(R2055).s: The bill is a Kingdom Act (rijkswet) approving a new bilateral tax treaty between the Netherlands and Sint Maarten, setting out allocation of taxing rights on income, double taxation relief, anti-abuse rules, and exchange of information. The explanatory memorandum says it largely follows the OECD model convention, with specific deviations for dividend withholding, pension and permanent establishment rules.
34263-(R2055).j: The memorandum justifies the treaty content by reference to OECD model conventions, the Netherlands' treaty policy (NFV 2011) and the prior agreement with Curaçao, rather than by delegation of new powers.
q: Thus it is that We, having heard the Advisory Division of the Council of State of the Kingdom and in common consultation with the States General, having regard to the provisions of the Statute for the Kingdom, have found and understood, as We do find and understand by these presents

Zo is het, dat Wij, de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State van het Koninkrijk gehoord, en met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, de bepalingen van het Statuut voor het Koninkrijk in acht genomen zijnde, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan
d: interaction with prior Brussels tax regulation and repeal of previous treaty provisions

parties: The VVD has read the tax arrangement and has no additional questions.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the Tax Arrangement between the Netherlands and Sint Maarten and have no further additional questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de Belastingregeling Nederland Sint Maarten en hebben verder geen aanvullende vragen.

The CDA questions the 15% withholding rate on pensions set without the parliamentary preference, questions the net pension scheme, and asks whether the unlimited substantial-interest reservation was discussed with Sint Maarten, pressing for accountability to parliament on treaty changes.

Therefore the members of the CDA faction would like to know whether the government has discussed the unlimited substantial-interest reservation with Sint Maarten as treaty partner and, if so, why no unlimited substantial-interest reservation was included in the arrangement.

Daarom vernemen de leden van de CDA-fractie graag of de regering het onbeperkte aanmerkelijkbelangvoorbehoud met Sint Maarten als verdragspartner heeft besproken en zo ja, waarom dan geen onbeperkt aanmerkelijkbelangvoorbehoud in de regeling is opgenomen.

Asks about the arbitration mechanism in Article 24 given the lack of a dispute settlement regime within the Kingdom, and about the absence of consultation of local stakeholders and of any socio-economic study.
Given that there is still no dispute settlement regime within the Kingdom, how will the arbitration set out in Article 24 be carried out?
Gelet op het feit dat er binnen het Koninkrijk nog steeds geen geschillenregeling is, hoe zal de arbitrage zoals neergelegd in artikel 24 worden uitgevoerd?

Asks how the tax regime will work in practice, including whether tax can be forwarded to the other country, and what the financial consequences are given the missing financial section in the explanatory memorandum.
What are the financial consequences of this regulation for Sint Maarten and also for the Netherlands, since a financial section is missing from the explanatory memorandum?
Wat zijn de financiële gevolgen van deze regeling voor Sint Maarten maar ook voor Nederland aangezien een financiële paragraaf in de memorie van toelichting ontbreekt?
Asks whether the regime will close gaps concerning persons working on Sint Maarten who are not residents.
asks whether this regulation will close gaps concerning persons who work on Sint Maarten but are not residents.
vraagt of deze regeling ervoor zal zorgen dat gaten betreffende personen die op Sint Maarten werken maar geen ingezetene zijn zullen worden gedicht?
Asks how far the duty to exchange information extends and seeks clarification on exemptions for businesses, raising privacy and scope questions for taxpayers.
How far does the obligation to exchange information, as laid down in the regulation, extend?
Hoe ver gaat de verplichting van uitwisseling van informatie zoals vastgesteld in de regeling?
Asks how the regime applies when company directors are not residents of Sint Maarten.
asks how it works if directors of a company are not residents of Sint Maarten.
vraagt hoe het zit indien bestuurders van een bedrijf geen ingezetene zijn van Sint Maarten?
Asks why local stakeholders were not consulted and suspects the process may be designed to enable detection of loopholes or to facilitate catching violations.
would like to be informed why local stakeholders were not consulted.
wordt graag op de hoogte gesteld waarom lokale stakeholders niet zijn geraadpleegd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the Netherlands–Sint Maarten tax regulation bill to parliament and the Sint Maarten Staten, but asked for clarification on consultation with the BES islands, the treatment of net pensions, and a de minimis threshold for mutual assistance in tax collection that the bill omitted despite the explanatory memorandum. The government reply, in the minister's words, adds the requested consultation information, clarifies net pension treatment, aligns the threshold text with the bill, and makes further drafting corrections.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum did not state whether the BES island councils were consulted on the bill, and the Afdeling asked for this to be added; the government supplemented the general part of the memorandum.

The bill and explanatory memorandum did not clarify whether net pensions fall under the pension provisions; the Afdeling asked for clarification and possible adjustment, and the government amended the commentary on article 17.

The explanatory memorandum stated a 1,500 euro de minimis threshold for mutual assistance in tax collection that was absent from the bill; the government aligned the commentary on article 26 with the bill.

The Afdeling listed several redactional corrections, including cross-references in articles 20 and 32, a punctuation fix in article 10, and a wording change in article 34, which the government implemented.

34300-XVI.s: This bill fixes the 2016 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the balance-sheet statements of its three baten-lastenagentschappen, in thousands of euros. The attached explanatory memorandum sets out budget policy, but the bill itself delegates no rule-making power and does not shift power from parliament or courts to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2016 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34475-XII.s: The bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (chapter XII) and the budget statements of its agencies (RWS, ILT, KNMI, NEa) through a final budget adjustment (Slotwet). It makes technical budget mutations, carries forward unspent amounts, and states that the law applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation adjustments, accounting-related adjustments, or adjustments arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

35047-(R2108).s: The bill amends the Paspoortwet to allow a public electronic identification means (publiek identificatiemiddel, assurance level high) to be placed on Dutch identity cards and travel documents, and expands the basisregister reisdocumenten with new data and disclosure grounds. It also broadens who may obtain a Dutch identity card, removes transitional provisions, and repeals the 2009 amending Rijkswet.
35047-(R2108).j: The memorandum justifies the wide delegation of technical detail by the need for flexibility as the digital infrastructure evolves and by the principle that processing must be foreseeable and transparent, with the specification of disclosure cases placed in general administrative measures.
q: By or pursuant to a general administrative measure of the Crown, rules are laid down on the technical and organisational arrangements necessary for producing and using the public identification means and the associated processing of data.

Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van rijksbestuur worden regels gesteld omtrent de technische en organisatorische inrichting van de voorzieningen die noodzakelijk zijn voor de vervaardiging en het kunnen gebruiken van het publiek identificatiemiddel en de daarmee samenhangende verwerking van gegevens.
d: designation of documents carrying the electronic identification means, data content, technical and organisational arrangements, fees
which bodies and persons may receive register data, disclosure methods, data to be recorded, retention and destruction periods
rules on management, security and reliability of the register
rules on processing of data in the issuing authorities' document administrations
extension of delegation to fix fees and rules for applications
data to be stated in applications for travel documents
documents to be submitted in the application and issuance process and their assessment and security
manner in which the minister checks whether grounds for refusal or invalidation still exist
implementing rules on the operation of the Paspoortwet
p: Core technical content of the electronic identification means and associated fee-setting is left to general administrative measures rather than the statute.

The minister may disclose register data to additional bodies and persons with a legitimate interest for purposes set by general administrative measure, with the categories of recipients left to delegated rules.
Extends the set of authorities competent to receive and issue Dutch identity cards without a new statutory safeguard.

parties: Asks how the central register and electronic identification will work, who bears costs of cards and card readers, and how Dutch citizens abroad are treated.
Who then has to pay for a new card with a new public means? Is that the citizen or the government, the VVD members ask.
Wie moet dan de kosten van een nieuwe kaart met een nieuw publiek middel betalen? Is dat de burger of de overheid, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Asks about the legal basis for placing the identification means, the parallel handling with the Wet digitale overheid, and the security risks of one central register.
How do both bills relate to each other, these members ask.
Hoe verhouden beide wetsvoorstellen zich tot elkaar, zo vragen deze leden.
Supports higher-assurance login but asks for justification of the central register, limits on data sharing for fraud prevention, and follow-up to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens concerns.
Nevertheless they ask the government to further explain the necessity of this central register, bringing together information now held in various places.
Toch vragen zij de regering nader de noodzaak van dit centrale register toe te lichten, waarbij informatie, die nu op verschillende plekken staat, bij elkaar wordt gezet.
Asks how the bill is received and how it can be implemented in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and the public bodies Bonaire, Sint-Eustatius and Saba.
Can the government indicate what this means in substantive terms for citizens from the Caribbean part of the Kingdom?
Kan de regering aangeven wat dit in materiele zin betekent voor de burgers uit het Caribische deel van het Koninkrijk?
Raises concerns that privacy of citizens may not have been adequately addressed, given black-market tools that could read, copy or misuse chip data, and asks for explanation of privacy safeguards.
There are a number of black market tools that are sparking which can read, copy and possibly misuse the information.
Er zijn een aantal black market tools die vonkend zijn die de informatie kunnen lezen, kopiëren en mogelijk misbruiken.
Asks for a presentation on advantages and disadvantages of the law so that the Centrale Commissie and a wider part of the Estates can debate it, implying a need for parliamentary scrutiny.
The faction would like to know whether the Estates can receive a presentation on the advantages and disadvantages of this law so that a discussion can be held in the Central Committee.
De fractie zou graag willen weten of de Staten een presentatie kan krijgen omtrent de voor- en nadelen van deze wet zodat een discussie kan worden gevoerd in de Centrale Commissie.
Asks about staffing, costs, the Gouverneur's new role and how the government will handle the Curaçao public administration's capacity, and wants more clarity on the purpose of the changes.
For the faction, it is not equally clear for all aspects what the proposed amendments are intended to achieve.
Het is voor de fractie niet voor alle aspecten even duidelijk wat met de voorgestelde wijzigingen wordt beoogd.
Asks which authority will issue the Dutch identity card in Curaçao, whether the public apparatus can handle the changes, and when public information campaigns will start.
Can the public apparatus bear the required changes?
Kan het publieke apparaat de vereiste veranderingen dragen?

Enthusiastic about digitalisation, but raises privacy protection, the gap with the Wdo that does not apply to Curaçao, and the proposal to regulate data access by amvrb rather than in the Paspoortwet itself.
The faction holds that where citizens' privacy is at stake, care must be taken with extra diligence.
De fractie meent namelijk dat daar waar privacy van burgers in het gedrang is, extra zorgvuldig dient te worden omgegaan.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises proceeding with a Rijkswet creating a higher-assurance chip-based electronic identification on identity documents, but asks for clarification on irrevocable withdrawal of the public identification means, fees, the position of other Kingdom countries, and a reservation about amendments to the Wdo. The government's reply accepts clarification in the explanatory memorandum, states the Kingdom-country matter is for those countries, and commits to resubmitting the bill if fundamental Wdo changes occur.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should clarify whether irrevocable withdrawal of the public identification means is a policy choice or technically necessary, and address fees for those who opt out and for those who later change their mind.

Citizens in other Kingdom countries can obtain electronic ID cards but cannot use the Wdo benefits until those countries adopt comparable rules, and the explanatory memorandum should address whether and when they plan to do so and ensure comparable safeguards.
The Raad asks that the bill be re-submitted for advice if amendments to the Wdo bill are fundamental, and the government commits to doing so.

35200-XVI.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) and the agency budget statements for the year 2018, in thousands of euros, with effect from the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of that budget year. The accompanying memorandum explains the 2018 supplementary expenditure and commitment changes, mainly the closing-account adjustments of about 0.7 billion euro.
q: The budget statements are established in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten geschiedt in duizenden euro's.

35350-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statements (second supplementary budget) of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the budget statement for agency DUO, adjusting appropriations and receipts across education, culture, research and emancipation articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendments effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2019.

35381-(R2143).s: This is a Rijkswet approving, for the entire Kingdom, the Additional Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism, adopted in Riga on 22 October 2015, as required under article 91(1) of the Constitution. The protocol requires parties to criminalise conduct linked to foreign terrorist fighters, and the government states it contains no provisions binding on individuals in the Dutch legal order.
q: In the government's view, the Additional Protocol contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat het Aanvullend Protocol geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet

parties: The VVD supports the protocol's aims and asks factual questions about non-ratification by other states, a current overview of international rules, and the choice of LIRC as contact point.
They endorse the aims of the protocol to oblige member states to criminalise a number of terrorist offences and to promote cooperation to prevent terrorism.
Zij onderschrijven de doelstellingen van het protocol om lidstaten te verplichten een aantal terroristische misdrijven strafbaar te stellen en samenwerking te bevorderen om terrorisme te voorkomen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the draft Kingdom Act approving the 2015 Riga Additional Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism raises no substantive remarks and should be submitted to parliament. The government's reply (nader rapport) notes that the explanatory memorandum was updated on signature and entry-into-force status and some editorial corrections were made.

35470-XV.s: This is a Dutch budget closing law (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for 2019, adjusting the departmental budget statement to reflect realised spending and commitments. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Realised expenditure is €8.8 million lower and realised commitments are €11.8 million lower than estimated in the Autumn Memorandum.
De gerealiseerde uitgaven zijn € 8,8 miljoen lager en de gerealiseerde verplichtingen zijn € 11,8 miljoen lager dan bij Najaarsnota was geraamd.

35650-XV.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (second supplementary budget), adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2020.
q: We ... have resolved, with the joint consent of the States General, that the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for 2020 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2020 wordt gewijzigd

35830-XV.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts per policy article to reflect the realised outcomes. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2020.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegeneid voor het jaar 2020;

36100-XIV.s: This bill is the Dutch Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) for 2021, which amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the agency budget, and the Animal Health Fund budget to reflect realised spending. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December 2021.
q: We ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2021 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd

36100-XVI.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the agency budget statement for that year, adjusting appropriations and realised figures. It sets the effective date and retroactive coverage to 31 December of the budget year, with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Spending on the Bonus for COVID-19 care professionals scheme, the Corona jobs in care scheme (COZO) and retraining of care staff came in €105 million lower than budgeted by VWS.

De uitgaven voor de regeling Bonus zorgprofessionals COVID-19, de regeling Coronabanen in de zorg (COZO) en het omscholen van zorgpersoneel is € 105 miljoen lager uitgevallen dan geraamd in de begroting van VWS.

36232-(R2174).s: The bill approves, for the whole Kingdom, the 2021 Treaty between the Netherlands and the United Arab Emirates on mutual legal assistance in criminal matters, as required by Article 91(1) of the Constitution. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
36232-(R2174).j: The memorandum justifies the treaty by the need to fight serious organised and financial crime with international cooperation, and notes safeguards for fundamental rights and data protection, but it does not justify any delegation of rule-making power.
q: Private persons have no entitlement to make requests for legal assistance, or to prevent the execution of such requests.
Er bestaat geen aanspraak van particulieren op het doen van verzoeken om rechtshulp, of om de uitvoering van verzoeken om rechtshulp te beletten.

parties: Asks whether refusal considerations, fundamental rights and the Protocol standards were applied, and asks for safeguards around exchange of data with the UAE.
However, these members hold that where data exchange with other countries is concerned, including in this case the United Arab Emirates, the necessary safeguards must be in place.
Wel moeten volgens deze leden waar het de uitwisseling van gegevens met andere landen betreft, waaronder in dit geval de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten (VAE), de nodige waarborgen zijn getroffen.
Questions whether evidence obtained via the UAE meets Article 6 ECHR and Dutch rules, and whether the Minister rather than a judge should decide on fundamental-rights concerns.
Asks about agreements on seizing criminal assets as part of prosecution.
These members ask the government to what extent agreements have been made, or will be made, on the ability to seize criminal assets as part of investigating and prosecuting criminals.

Deze leden vragen aan de regering in hoeverre afspraken zijn gemaakt, of in de toekomst gemaakt zullen worden, over het kunnen afpakken van crimineel vermogen als onderdeel van de opsporing en vervolging van criminelen.
Asks whether suspects can get a fair trial and adequate legal protection in the UAE, given the independence of its judiciary, and whether data protection should be in the treaty.
Do suspects in criminal investigations have a fair chance with adequate legal protection to defend themselves in the UAE?
Hebben verdachten van strafrechtelijke onderzoeken wel een eerlijke kans met adequate rechtsbescherming om zich in de VAE te kunnen verdedigen?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion on the draft law approving the 2021 mutual legal assistance treaty with the UAE says the explanatory memorandum must assess the UAE's human rights situation, given the trust principle underlying cooperation and the court's restrained review. The government's reply accepts this starting point with caveats, and adds a new section on human rights aspects and on the Kingdom-wide extension.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the memorandum assess the UAE human rights situation (torture, fair trial, political prisoners, monitoring), which the government addresses by adding a new section 1.4 but only partly accepts the Afdeling's stricter reading.
The Afdeling's remarks on the treaty's trust-based framework are noted, with the government stating that a balancing of interests applies when establishing cooperation.

36250-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the DUO agency, implementing a second supplementary budget. It changes appropriations, revenues and investment and loan figures in the attached budget statements, effective from the day after publication and retroactive to 30 November 2022.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for 2022 is amended, as shown in the attached statement.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd

36323-(R2182).s: This Rijkswet approves for the whole Kingdom the 1996 Hazardous and Noxious Substances (HNS) Convention and its 2010 Protocol on liability and compensation for maritime carriage of hazardous substances. It also provides that future changes to the Convention's liability limits do not require parliamentary approval.
36323-(R2182).j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the bill by the Constitution requiring parliamentary approval for treaties, and states that the HNS Fund compensates victims when shipowner liability is capped, without addressing the reasoning for Article 2.
q: Amendments to the liability limits of the Convention, made in accordance with Article 48 of the Convention, do not require approval by the States General.
Wijzigingen van de aansprakelijkheidslimieten van het Verdrag, tot stand gekomen overeenkomstig artikel 48 van het Verdrag, behoeven niet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal.
d: amendments to liability limits under treaty Article 48 without Staten-Generaal approval
p: Changes to the Convention's liability limits adopted under the treaty's amendment procedure would not require approval by the Staten-Generaal.

parties: Asks how compliance by non-member states' shipowners with insurance requirements is enforced, how unfair competition is prevented, how liability limits and damage recovery work, and how claimants are identified.
These members want to know how it is enforced that shipowners from non-member states actually hold insurance, and how unfair competition from non-member states is prevented.

Deze leden willen weten hoe wordt gehandhaafd dat scheepseigenaren van landen die geen lid zijn van het HNS-Verdrag ook daadwerkelijk een verzekering hebben, en hoe oneerlijke concurrentie van landen die geen lid zijn van het HNS-Verdrag wordt voorkomen.
Asks how the level of mandatory contributions to the HNS Fund is assessed, whether hazardousness is weighed, and why receivers of packaged substances are exempt despite fund coverage.
They ask what considerations preceded this choice.
Zij vragen zich af welke afweging hieraan vooraf is gegaan.
Notes the unusually long ratification period and asks what options exist to speed up the treaty process and whether legal starting points exist for talks with other countries.
Could the government explain what options it sees for accelerating the treaty process and the introduction of such treaties?
Zou de regering willen toelichten welke mogelijkheden zij ziet tot versnelling van het proces van verdragen en de invoering van dergelijke verdragen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom advised without substantive remarks on a draft rijkswet approving the 1996 HNS Convention and the 2010 Protocol on liability and compensation for damage from maritime carriage of hazardous and noxious substances. The minister's reply (nader rapport) merely forwards the advice and confirms the bill will be sent to the parliaments.

36410-XIII.s: This is the 2024 budget bill (Wet vaststelling begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII), setting departmental expenditure and receipts and the budgets of the operating agencies for 2024. The explanatory memorandum extract describes budget policy, subsidy schemes, guarantees and agency funding but contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this act for the year 2024 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2024 budget bill for the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (XIII) and raised no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The text is a cover document listing the Raad's advice on the full set of 2024 budget bills, with the Minister of Finance's transmittal; no government reply to substantive points is included.

36550-XV.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2024 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, adjusting expenditure and commitments across benefits, childcare, sickness and leave schemes according to updated economic forecasts and 2023 realisations. The bill itself only sets budget figures and entry into force; it does not delegate rule-making or shift power away from checks.
36550-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by updated CPB forecasts of unemployment and realised 2023 expenditure, not by any new executive powers.
q: Because the CPB expects a lower unemployed labour force in the coming years, benefit expenditure is adjusted downward
Doordat het CPB een lagere werkloze beroepsbevolking verwacht in de komende jaren, worden de bijstandsuitgaven neerwaarts bijgesteld

36613-XV.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, together with the agency and budget fund statements, through a first and September supplementary budget with changes across social security and employment articles. It is a budgetary bill that adjusts appropriations and receipts and does not itself delegate rule-making or shift powers between branches.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2024;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid voor het jaar 2024;

36725-XII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) and the budget statement for its agencies (Rijkswaterstaat and KNMI), shifting appropriations and expenditure across policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 June 2025.
q: We ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement ... is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat ... wordt gewijzigd

36800-XX.s: This bill formally establishes the 2026 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Asylum and Migration and the budget statement for the IND agency, in thousands of euros. The explanatory memorandum describes budget allocations, planned asylum and migration policy measures, and an evaluation agenda for return policy.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2026 is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued a blanket advisory opinion on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Asylum and Migration, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's reply notes that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes not included in the text.

36820-XV.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statements (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, the agency budget and the budget fund, applying the September supplementary budget amendments with retroactive effect to 16 September 2025. It is a budgetary appropriation law that sets expenditure and commitment figures in thousands of euros and does not itself delegate rule-making or shift power away from checks.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid voor het jaar 2025

36834-(R2211).s: The bill amends the Tax Arrangement Netherlands Sint Maarten to implement OECD BEPS outcomes, adjusting permanent establishment rules, treaty abuse protection, withholding tax and arbitration procedures. It also removes obsolete articles 30, 33 and 34 and sets entry into force.
36834-(R2211).j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementing BEPS outcomes and aligning with the OECD model treaty, without new executive powers.
q: Benefits under the arrangement are denied where obtaining the benefit was one of the principal purposes of an arrangement, unless granting it would be consistent with the object and purpose of the provisions.

Artikel 22 1. Niettegenstaande de overige bepalingen van deze rijkswet, wordt een voordeel uit hoofde van de rijkswet niet toegekend met betrekking tot een inkomensbestanddeel indien, alle relevante feiten en omstandigheden in aanmerking genomen, redelijkerwijs kan worden geconcludeerd dat het verkrijgen van dit voordeel een van de voornaamste redenen was voor een constructie of transactie

parties: Asks whether the considerans and minimum standards apply in a purely domestic Kingdom situation and whether Dutch obligation to include them exists, and asks about the arbitration exception and arbiter selection.
Can the government explain how this minimum standard applies in a purely internal situation, that is, within the Kingdom of the Netherlands?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe deze minimumstandaard van toepassing is in een zuiver interne situatie: dat wil zeggen binnen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden?
Asks about the planned revision of Sint Maarten's tax system, the reasons for referring to ATAD 1 and 2 and the Wet bronbelasting 2001, and the implementation and taxpayer effects.
The GroenLinks-PvdA members ask what the mentioned revision of the Sint Maarten tax system entails and what consequences it will have for the present proposal.
De leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie vragen wat de genoemde revisie van het belastingstelsel in Sint Maarten inhoudt en wat voor gevolgen deze revisie zal hebben voor het voorliggende voorstel.
Welcomes the introduction of minimum standards against tax avoidance in Sint Maarten and has no further questions.
These members think it good that the minimum standards for combating tax avoidance are now also being introduced in Sint Maarten and have no further questions on the bill.
Deze leden vinden het goed dat de minimumstandaarden voor bestrijding van belastingontwijking nu ook op Sint-Maarten worden ingevoerd en hebben geen verdere vragen bij het wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised without any remarks that the draft Kingdom Act amending the Belastingregeling Nederland Sint Maarten, implementing OECD BEPS outcomes, be submitted to the Tweede Kamer and the Estates of Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten. The government's nader rapport notes only minor editorial changes made to the bill and explanatory memorandum, with no substantive points to respond to.
